How it works

Four steps, one visit

What happens from the moment our technician arrives at your door.

Step 01

Inspect

We check the dryer connection, the hose condition and the baseline airflow before touching anything.

Step 02

Extract

A rotary brush is fed the full length of the duct, pulling packed lint and debris back out as it goes.

Step 03

Clear the cap

The exterior vent cap is opened and cleared of lint, debris and any bird nesting restricting the flap.

Step 04

Verify

Airflow is measured again, the system is reassembled and sealed, and we show you what came out.

FAQ

Questions we get asked

If yours is not here, call or text and we will answer it directly.

How often should a dryer vent be cleaned?+
Once a year suits most households. If you run laundry five or more times a week, or you have pets, every six months is safer. The signs you are overdue: clothes needing a second cycle, the dryer casing feeling hot, or a musty smell in the laundry room.
How long does a visit take?+
A standard residential vent takes about 45 to 60 minutes. Long duct runs, rooftop outlets and condo vertical stacks can take up to 90 minutes. We quote the time along with the price before starting.
Which parts of the GTA do you cover?+
The whole region: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Oakville, Burlington, Ajax, Pickering and the surrounding communities.
Can a blocked vent genuinely start a fire?+
Yes. Lint is highly flammable, and failure to clean is the leading contributing factor in residential dryer fires. A blocked duct traps heat against that lint with nowhere for it to escape. Annual cleaning is one of the simplest fire-prevention steps available to a homeowner.
Do I need to be home?+
Yes. We need access to the dryer indoors and to the exterior vent cap, which in some buildings means roof or utility access. We arrange an arrival window that works for you.
What does it cost?+
Pricing depends on the duct length and where the vent exits, so we quote it on the call before booking. There are no call-out fees and no charges added afterwards.
